info.title: wow-migrate
info.description: Web-free SQL migrator CLI (`wow-migrate`) over the WoW Two be sdk bespoke migrator — status, apply (+--dry-run), check, new, promote, rollback, verify (+--repair) against a Postgres database, for one migration set or every set in a --sets manifest.

options.name: --sql-dir
options.description: Migrations dir of a single set (else WOW_MIGRATE_SQL_DIR, else auto-discovered).

options.name: --sets
options.description: Migration-sets manifest (JSON) listing every set (else WOW_MIGRATE_SETS); verbs run all of them unless --set picks one.

options.name: --set
options.description: Run one named set: pick it from --sets, or name the set read from --sql-dir (else 'default').

options.name: --schema
options.description: Schema of a single set: holds its history and fills {{schema}} (else 'public').

options.name: --schema-owner
options.description: Claim the single set's schema under this owner; creates the schema and refuses one claimed by another owner.

options.name: --owner-instance
options.description: The instance the single set's schema is claimed as (required with --schema-owner): the host's Migrations:OwnerInstance, else {applicationName}@{DEPLOY_ENVIRONMENT}.

commands.name: apply
commands.description: Ensure the DB exists, then apply pending migrations (or rehearse them with --dry-run).

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Rehearse pending migrations in one transaction and roll back; exit 2 when one fails. Never creates the DB. [default: False]

commands.name: check
commands.description: Exit 1 unless every set's database level matches its source; writes nothing.

commands.name: rollback
commands.description: Roll back the latest migration (or down to ordinal N) of one set. Dev only.

options.name: --to
options.description: Roll back down to this ordinal (else just the latest).

options.name: --i-understand-this-is
options.description: Confirm the target database name (must match the connection's database).

options.name: --force
options.description: Skip the interactive [y/N] confirmation prompt. [default: False]

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Exit 1 on checksum drift; --repair re-records edited checksums.

options.name: --repair
options.description: Re-record edited checksums of one set instead of failing on drift. [default: False]

options.name: --i-understand-this-is
options.description: Confirm the target database name (required with --repair).

options.name: --force
options.description: Skip the interactive [y/N] confirmation prompt when repairing. [default: False]

commands.name: baseline
commands.description: Mark one set's migrations as applied without running them; refuses a set that records history.

options.name: --to
options.description: Mark migrations up to and including this ordinal (else every source migration).

options.name: --i-understand-this-is
options.description: Confirm the target database name (must match the connection's database).

options.name: --force
options.description: Skip the interactive [y/N] confirmation prompt. [default: False]
